aboutPage.whoWeAreDescription1: We are a community of believers aspiring to be an authentic Christian community that glorifies Christ in both proclamation and lifestyle. Though we are not a gathering of perfect people, yet as a community, we believe that we are in the process of sanctification. This is why we strive to devote ourselves to studying Scripture, prayer, fellowship and the sharing of resources.
aboutPage.whoWeAreDescription2: It is our conviction that the church is the steward of the message of the Good News, the only message of hope for fallen humanity. It is through this message that people can gain salvation and have access to a personal relationship with God. It is thus our mission to spread this Good News in every way possible and make peoples disciples of Christ.
aboutPage.aspireTitle: We aspire to be a church that is:

aspireContent.communityLife: Suitable for community life to flourish
aspireContent.believersGrowth: A place where believers grow in to maturity
aspireContent.broadMinistry: Broad in ministry, so that believers able to exercise their gift

ourBelief.bibleBody: We believe the Bible (the sixty-six books of the Old and the New Testament) is the Word of God fully inspired by the Holy Spirit. It is worthy of our obedience and faith with final authority and sufficiency for faith and practice. It is the sole source of the church’s faith and practice.
ourBelief.GodBody: We believe in one God who exists in three persons: God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
ourBelief.fatherGodBody: We believe God the Father is omnipotent, omniscient, omnipresent, sovereign creator, and sustainer of all things. We also believe He is a truthful, Holy, Loving, eternal, and immutable God. Because of His great love, He sent His only begotten Son to the world for the salvation of mankind.
ourBelief.sonGodBody: We believe Jesus Christ is the eternal Son of God, conceived in the Spirit and born from the Virgin Mary. He is fully divine and fully human. We believe these two natures exist in one person without confusion, separation, division, and change. Jesus died for the redemption of mankind, resurrected from death on the third day, and ascended to heaven in glory. Now he intercedes for us in the right hand of God, and He will come back in glory to judge the living and the dead.
ourBelief.spiritGodBody: We believe the Holy Spirit is coequal with the Father and the Son, a God worthy of worship and praise. He convicts the world of sin, righteousness, and judgment. He leads believers into all the truth, comforts us, helps us, enables us to live a sanctified life, and equips us with power and spiritual gifts and power for ministry.
ourBelief.manBody: We believe God created man in His image, for His glory, and to fellowship with Him. We believe man is a steward responsible for working and caring for creation. But because of sin, man has fallen, separated from God, and is under the judgment of God.
ourBelief.salvationBody: We believe that mankind has fallen because of sin. The only way to be saved from the judgment of God is through the redemptive work of Jesus Christ. We believe Salvation is the gift of God. His work and effort can’t save mankind. A sinner can be a new creation through faith in the work of Christ on the cross. Because of this, the Holy Spirit will dwell in him to sanctify him daily through continual obedience and make him grow towards Christlikeness.
ourBelief.churchBody: The church is an assembly of born-again believers who accepted Jesus Christ as their Lord and Savior. Christ is the head of His body, the church. The church's mission is to expand the kingdom of God, worship God, evangelize the lost, and make disciples. To accomplish this mission, the Holy Spirit equipped the church with spiritual gifts, still working these days, and to prepare believers for the ministry he calls Christian ministers. And we believe God has given holy sacraments, baptism and the Lord’s Supper to the church.
ourBelief.baptismBody: We believe that through baptism, the believer expresses his cooperation with the death and resurrection of Christ. He displays his death for sin and resurrection for righteousness with Christ through baptism. This sacrament is done in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit by immersion in the water.
ourBelief.lordSupperBody: We believe that the Lord’s Supper is a sacrament that the believers remember and declare the death of Christ.
ourBelief.marriageBody: We believe marriage is a life-long commitment between one man and one woman, inaugurated by a covenantal promise in the face of God and witnesses.
ourBelief.angelsBody: We believe that holy angels are spiritual creatures. As the Bible teaches us, they worship God, are messengers who perform the will of God, serve saints sent when ordered by God, and are creatures superior to man in knowledge and power./nWe believe the fallen angel or Satan has rebelled against God, and he was followed by other fallen angels. Together, they do evil in the present world. We believe that they are always against God’s plan and work. Even though they have power, this power is under the control of God. Jesus Christ defeated Satan and the fallen angels by His work on the cross. They are under judgment and finally will be cast to hell forever.
ourBelief.secondComingTitle: 7. Eschatology and the Second Coming of Jesus Christ
ourBelief.secondComingBody: We believe that our Lord Jesus Christ will return physically in glory. This phenomenon will be the end of history. At that time, there will be a resurrection of the saints, while those who passed away believing in Him will inherit eternal bliss with believers alive on earth when he comes again. Those who did not believe in him will endure eternal judgment and punishment.

intro.page2Subtitle: Join us as we journey together towards a deeper understanding of God's Word and a closer walk with Christ. We are a community dedicated to spiritual growth and mutual support.
intro.page3Subtitle: We are a church committed to proclaiming the Good News of salvation. Through various ministries and outreach efforts, we strive to reach people with the love of Christ.
intro.page4Subtitle: Discover the joy of connecting with like-minded believers. We invite you to join us for inspiring worship, insightful Bible studies, and meaningful fellowship.
intro.page5Title: Becoming More Like Christ, One Day at a Time
